decisions.reason: A particle therapy water phantom extends the firm's decades of dosimetry and scanning know-how into a niche it can interpret and refine, though its website presence shrank to a mention in 2019, a sign of somewhat weaker commitment.
Small volume ionization chambers are at the core of the firm's dosimetry expertise and accredited calibration capabilities, so it can readily assimilate feedback and improve them.
This small field chamber builds directly on the firm's existing detector knowledge and kept a dedicated page through 2019, so retention is likely.
A standard clinical chamber line with several models is a staple of the firm's established dosimetry business, closely related to its knowledge base and calibration services.
Relative dosimetry chambers complement the firm's water phantoms and scanning systems and draw on its core competence, which favours keeping them.
Thimble ionization chambers are classic dosimetry products within the firm's deep expertise and support its integrated QA offering.
